concepts.definition: Monotonic allocation state for one typed number family and stable scope, including its explicit legacy high-water cutover checkpoint.
Immutable association of one number with one typed resource inside one Number Series; committed allocations are never released or reused.

relationships.meaning: Issue authorizes and creates its stable resource, then obtains an idempotent Repository work-item number in the same transaction; Numbering owns the shared Issue/future Pull Request series.
Discussion retains lifecycle, authorization and replay while Numbering allocates the Repository Discussion number in the same transaction.
Repository retains Milestone lifecycle, authorization and replay while Numbering allocates the Repository Milestone number in the same transaction.
Project retains Project and View lifecycle, authorization, version and replay while Numbering allocates Account-scoped Project and Project-scoped View numbers in the same transaction.

capabilities.intent: Allocate and resolve positive monotonic numbers inside typed stable scopes with immutable committed allocations and idempotency by resource.

implementation.scope: Repository work-item, Discussion and Milestone series; Account Project series; Project View series
implementation.note: Allocation uses the caller Sql transaction after the resource Owner has validated and locked its scope. Committed allocations are never reset, released or reused; rollback does not commit an allocation. Pull Request is a compatible inactive resource kind sharing repository-work-item, not an activated runtime capability.
